svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.8.9.1 Loads on Stairs and Ramps
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.8.9.1 Loads on Stairs and Ramps
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.8 STAIRS, RAMPS, LANDINGS, HANDRAILS AND GUARDS

g.text: one dwelling unit or a house

svg.text: Stairs and ramps are designed for strength and
rigidity under uniform loading criteria, to
(a) 1.9 kPa (39.7 psf) for stairs and ramps
serving not more than one dwelling unit or a
house with a secondary suite including their
common spaces, and (b) 4.8 kPa (100 psf) for
Drawn: a wood stair in a house and a concrete stair elsewhere. Arrows show a uniform load on the treads.
